description: FREE schema & DOM preview (3 calls/hour per IP). Runs the exact same headless Chromium + LLM extraction pass as paid runs so null/missing fields match 1:1, while masking populated values with type placeholders.

dynamic.description: Use headless Chromium (default true). Set false for static HTML fetch.

raw_text.description: Optional raw text snippet instead of a URL.

target_schema.description: JSON schema to test against the page.

url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL to test extraction against.

wait_ms.description: Optional extra delay in ms (0-3000) after network idle.
